techStack: Vitest v4 with globals enabled; run tests with `npm run test` (vitest run) inside src/benchmark-backend
TypeScript strict mode is OFF; but noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch are on — unused symbols cause compile errors
verbatimModuleSyntax is set — type-only imports must use `import type`
No linting or formatting tooling (no ESLint, no Prettier)
Express v5, no database — data is fetched from dummyjson.com and cached in memory by dataFetcher.ts
noEmit: true — tsc used only for type-checking; tsx handles transpilation for dev/test
features: getAllProducts: fetches all products, copies to mutable array, applies search/category/inStock filters sequentially, applies sort, computes pagination, returns envelope
sanitizeSearch: trims and lowercases a string — exported but never called inside productService.ts (inline logic is used instead) and never imported anywhere else; dead code
Filter — search: `query.search !== undefined` guard, then inline `trim().toLowerCase()`, filters on `p.name.toLowerCase().includes(term)`
Filter — category: `query.category !== undefined` guard, case-insensitive equality `p.category.toLowerCase() === query.category!.toLowerCase()`

Filter — inStock: `query.inStock !== undefined` outer guard (required — preserves `false` semantics), then inner `if (query.inStock === true)` / `else` with explicit `=== false` (redundant — replaceable with `p.inStock === query.inStock`)
Sort: four independent `if` blocks (all evaluated even after a match), each spreads result before sorting — price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc
Pagination: page defaults to `query.page ?? 1`, limit to `query.limit ?? 10`; total = filtered length; totalPages = Math.ceil(total/limit); data = result.slice((page-1)*limit, page*limit)
Envelope: `{ data, total, page, limit, totalPages }` typed as PaginatedResponse<Product>
DEFAULT_LIMIT = 10 constant is declared at module scope but never referenced (literal 10 used inline)
architecture: Layer order: routes → middleware (requireAuth) → controller (productController.ts) → service (productService.ts) → data (dataFetcher.ts)
productController.ts calls parseProductQuery then delegates to getAllProducts; does not touch filtering/sorting logic
dataFetcher.ts exports a single function `fetchAllProducts(): Promise<Product[]>` with module-level cache
Types imported from ../types/product: Product, ProductQuery, PaginatedResponse<T>
Convention: module-scope helpers are placed BEFORE the main exported function — new filterProducts and sortProducts must go above getAllProducts
sanitizeSearch is not imported in any other source or test file — safe to delete without touching any other file
Only src/benchmark-backend/src/services/productService.ts is in scope; all other files are read-only references
edgeCases: inStock === false: the `query.inStock !== undefined` outer guard must be preserved — if replaced with `if (query.inStock)`, the false case would be silently skipped, breaking the 'filters out-of-stock products' test
Removing inner `=== true`/`=== false` checks: safe — replacing with `p.inStock === query.inStock` is semantically identical when inStock is typed as boolean | undefined
Unknown sort value: all four conditions fail, result is returned in current order — else-if chain reproduces this exactly (at most one branch matches)
Converting 4 independent ifs to else-if: no fall-through risk — each branch checks a distinct string literal; semantics are identical
sanitizeSearch removal: no external callers; a hidden test (`hidden.structure.test.ts`) explicitly asserts the export does NOT exist — removal is required
query.search !== undefined guard: keep as-is — switching to `if (query.search)` would silently skip filtering for an empty string (behavioral change, even if no test covers it)
Pagination arithmetic and envelope shape must be byte-for-byte identical in getAllProducts after refactor — filterProducts and sortProducts must not alter total or data semantics

tasks.description: Delete the `sanitizeSearch` function (lines 6-9 of productService.ts) including its comment. No other file references it.

tasks.requirement: 1, 5 — filterProducts exists at module scope handling all three filter dimensions; no redundant boolean comparisons remain
tasks.description: Add a module-scope function `filterProducts(products: Product[], query: ProductQuery): Product[]` before `getAllProducts`. It must handle all three filter dimensions in order: (1) search — keep `query.search !== undefined` guard, inline trim/lowercase; (2) category — keep `query.category !== undefined` guard, case-insensitive equality; (3) inStock — keep `query.inStock !== undefined` outer guard, replace the inner `if (query.inStock === true) … else …` with a single `filter(p => p.inStock === query.inStock)` (eliminates `=== true` and `=== false`).

tasks.requirement: 2, 6 — sortProducts exists at module scope handling all four sort variants; sort logic uses a single if/else-if chain
tasks.description: Add a module-scope function `sortProducts(products: Product[], sort: ProductQuery['sort']): Product[]` before `getAllProducts`. It must handle all four sort variants using a single `if / else if / else if / else if` chain (not four independent ifs): price_asc, price_desc, name_asc, name_desc — each spreading the array before sorting. An unrecognised sort value must fall through without sorting, matching current behaviour.

tasks.requirement: 1, 2, 3, 9 — getAllProducts follows exact orchestration order fetch → filter → sort → paginate → return; no filter or sort logic inlined; envelope shape preserved
tasks.description: Rewrite the body of `getAllProducts` to be a thin orchestrator: (1) `const products = await fetchAllProducts()`, (2) `const filtered = filterProducts(products, query)`, (3) `const sorted = sortProducts(filtered, query.sort)`, (4) pagination arithmetic on `sorted` (total, page, limit, totalPages, data slice) — identical to current formulas, (5) return `{ data, total, page, limit, totalPages }`. No `.filter(` or `.sort(` calls may remain inside `getAllProducts`.
